verdict.rationale: llamafile documents an official CLI arguments reference, a `--cli` mode, and bundled default arguments that can be set when building a llamafile. It also ships GPU acceleration for Metal, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan, so command-line model configuration is plausible. However, no evidence names a GPU-layer offload flag or a context-length flag, and one community user could not work out how to move processing onto the GPU. Missing for 10: documented GPU offload flag (e.g. layer count), documented context-length flag, hands-on corroboration of tuning these settings from the command line.
